FAQ

The most asked questions from our previous clients


Do I need prior trading experience?

+

No, the system was designed specifically for complete beginners. You will receive clear, step-by-step guidance—starting from scratch—that will enable you to execute your first trade with confidence, requiring no prior financial or technical background.

What Will I Learn During the Session?

+

You'll get personal insights into my trading strategy, market analysis, risk management, and the techniques I use in my own trading.

Are These Private 1-on-1 Video Calls?

+

Yes! Every session is private and one-on-one, giving you the opportunity to ask questions and get personalized guidance directly from me.

Will You Guarantee Profits or Trading Results?

+

No trading strategy can guarantee profits. These sessions are designed for education and guidance, helping you develop your trading knowledge and decision-making skills.

How Do I Book a Session With You?

+

Simply choose an available time from the booking calendar, complete your payment, and you'll receive the details needed to join your private video session.

What happens after applying?

+

We will contact you via the email address you provided in the field to discuss exactly what you want to learn, the times, and payment for the mentorship lessons.
